#1
ये|ye|yad — who, which (ye: nom. pl. masc. relative)
शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य|śāstra-vidhim utsṛjya|śāstra — scripture, sacred teaching (first member);;vidhi — injunction, rule (śāstra-vidhim: 'the injunction of scripture', acc. sg. masc., object of utsṛjya; simply joined with utsṛjya);;ut-sṛj — to abandon, cast aside (utsṛjya: gerund, 'having abandoned')
यजन्ते|yajante|yaj — to sacrifice (yajante: present middle 3rd pl., 'they sacrifice')
श्रद्धयान्विताः|śraddhayā anvitāḥ|śraddhā — faith (instr. sg. 'with faith');;anvita — endowed with, possessed of (past participle of anu-i; anvitāḥ: nom. pl. masc., agreeing with the implied subject 'those who'; śraddhayā+anvitāḥ→śraddhayānvitāḥ, ā+a→ā)
--
तेषां|teṣām|tad — they (teṣām: gen. pl. 'of them')
निष्ठा|niṣṭhā|niṣṭhā — steadfastness, standing, fixed state (nom. sg. fem., subject)
तु|tu|tu — but, now (particle)
का|kā|kim — what? (kā: nom. sg. fem. interrogative)
कृष्ण|kṛṣṇa|Kṛṣṇa — Kṛṣṇa (vocative)
सत्त्वमाहो|sattvam āho|sattva — sattva, kept untranslated, one of the three guṇas (nom. sg. neut.);;āho — or (interrogative disjunctive particle; sattvam+āho simply joined, final -m unaffected before the vowel)
रजस्तमः|rajaḥ tamaḥ|rajas — rajas, kept untranslated (nom. sg. neut.; -aḥ+t-→-as t-);;tamas — tamas, kept untranslated (nom. sg. neut.)
#2
त्रिविधा|trividhā|tri-vidha — threefold (trividhā: nom. sg. fem., agreeing with śraddhā)
भवति|bhavati|bhū — to be, become (bhavati: present 3rd sg.)
श्रद्धा|śraddhā|śraddhā — faith (nom. sg. fem., subject)
देहिनां|dehinām|dehin — the embodied [being] (dehinām: gen. pl., 'of embodied beings')
सा|sā|tad — she, it (sā: nom. sg. fem., resuming śraddhā)
स्वभावजा|svabhāvajā|sva-bhāva-ja — born of one's own nature (nom. sg. fem., predicate)
--
सात्त्विकी|sāttvikī|sāttvika — sattva-natured, of the nature of sattva (sāttvikī: nom. sg. fem.; sattva kept untranslated per convention)
राजसी|rājasī|rājasa — rajas-natured, of the nature of rajas (nom. sg. fem.; rajas kept untranslated)
चैव|ca eva|ca — and;;eva — indeed (ca+eva→caiva, a+e→ai)
तामसी|tāmasī|tāmasa — tamas-natured, of the nature of tamas (nom. sg. fem.; tamas kept untranslated)
चेति|ca iti|ca — and (ca+iti→ceti, a+i→e);;iti — thus (closing the enumeration)
तां|tām|tad — that, it (tām: acc. sg. fem., object of śṛṇu, referring to śraddhā)
शृणु|śṛṇu|śru — to hear (śṛṇu: imperative 2nd sg., 'hear!')
#3
सत्त्वानुरूपा|sattva-anurūpā|sattva — one's own being, disposition (here the individual's inner nature or constitution, not the guṇa named in its narrower sense — see note; first member);;anurūpa — conforming to, corresponding to (sattva-anurūpā: 'conformed to one's own nature', nom. sg. fem., predicate; a+a→ā)
सर्वस्य|sarvasya|sarva — every, all (sarvasya: gen. sg. 'of everyone, of each')
श्रद्धा|śraddhā|śraddhā — faith (nom. sg. fem., subject)
भवति|bhavati|bhū — to be, become (bhavati: present 3rd sg.)
भारत|bhārata|Bhārata — descendant of Bharata, Arjuna (vocative)
--
श्रद्धामयोऽयं|śraddhā-mayaḥ ayam|śraddhā — faith (first member);;maya — made of, consisting of (śraddhā-mayaḥ: 'made of faith', nom. sg. masc., predicate; -aḥ+a-→-o' with avagraha);;idam — this (ayam: nom. sg. masc., subject)
पुरुषो|puruṣaḥ|puruṣa — a person, a man (nom. sg. masc., subject; -aḥ before y-→-o)
यो|yaḥ|yad — who (yaḥ: nom. sg. masc. relative; -aḥ before y-→-o)
यच्छ्रद्धः|yat-śraddhaḥ|yad — what, whatever (first member; -t+ś-→-c ch-);;śraddha — having ... faith (bahuvrīhi compound member; yat-śraddhaḥ: 'he whose faith is what [it is]', nom. sg. masc.)
स|sa|tad — he (sa: nom. sg. masc.; the pronoun sa/eṣa always drops its visarga before a following consonant)
एव|eva|eva — indeed, precisely
सः|saḥ|tad — he (saḥ: nom. sg. masc., repeated for emphasis, 'he is precisely that')
#4
यजन्ते|yajante|yaj — to sacrifice (yajante: present middle 3rd pl.)
सात्त्विका|sāttvikāḥ|sāttvika — sattva-natured, belonging to sattva (nom. pl. masc.; -āḥ before d-→-ā)
देवान्यक्षरक्षांसि|devān yakṣa-rakṣāṃsi|deva — god (devān: acc. pl., object of yajante in the first clause);;yakṣa — a yakṣa, a class of demigod, a nature-spirit (first member);;rakṣas — a rākṣasa, a class of demon (yakṣa-rakṣāṃsi: 'yakṣas and rākṣasas', acc. pl. neut. dvandva, object of yajante understood in the second clause)
राजसाः|rājasāḥ|rājasa — rajas-natured, belonging to rajas (nom. pl. masc., subject)
--
प्रेतान्भूतगणांश्चान्ये|pretān bhūta-gaṇān ca anye|preta — a departed spirit, a ghost (pretān: acc. pl., object of yajante);;bhūta-gaṇa — a host of bhūtas, spirits, elemental beings (bhūtagaṇān: acc. pl.; -n+c-→-ṃś c-);;ca — and;;anya — other (anye: nom. pl. masc., agreeing with janāḥ; ca+anye→cānye, a+a→ā)
यजन्ते|yajante|yaj — to sacrifice (yajante: present middle 3rd pl.)
तामसा|tāmasāḥ|tāmasa — tamas-natured, belonging to tamas (nom. pl. masc.; -āḥ before j-→-ā)

#5
अशास्त्रविहितं|a-śāstra-vihitam|a-śāstra — not [enjoined by] scripture (first member);;vihita — enjoined, ordained (past participle of vi-dhā; a-śāstra-vihitam: 'not enjoined by scripture', acc. sg. neut., agreeing with tapaḥ)
घोरं|ghoram|ghora — terrible, dreadful (acc. sg. neut.)
तप्यन्ते|tapyante|tap — to practice austerity, to torment oneself (tapyante: present middle 3rd pl.)
ये|ye|yad — who (ye: nom. pl. masc. relative)
तपो|tapaḥ|tapas — austerity (acc. sg. neut., object of tapyante, 'practice austerity'; -aḥ before j-→-o)
जनाः|janāḥ|jana — a person, people (nom. pl. masc., subject)
--
दम्भाहंकारसंयुक्ताः|dambha-ahaṃkāra-saṃyuktāḥ|dambha — hypocrisy, ostentation (first member);;ahaṃkāra — egotism, the sense of 'I' (second member);;saṃyukta — joined with, endowed with (past participle of sam-yuj; dambha-ahaṃkāra-saṃyuktāḥ: 'joined with hypocrisy and egotism', nom. pl. masc., predicate)
कामरागबलान्विताः|kāma-rāga-bala-anvitāḥ|kāma — desire (first member);;rāga — passion, attachment (second member);;bala — force, power (third member; bala+anvitāḥ→balānvitāḥ, a+a→ā);;anvita — possessed by, filled with (kāma-rāga-bala-anvitāḥ: 'possessed by the force of desire and passion', nom. pl. masc., predicate)
#6
कर्षयन्तः|karṣayantaḥ|kṛṣ — to drag, torment, afflict (karṣayant-: causative present participle, 'tormenting, dragging down'; karṣayantaḥ: nom. pl. masc. — the vulgate reading, printed here; the BORI critical edition reads karśayantaḥ, from kṛś 'to make thin, emaciate, waste away' — 'emaciating' — in its place: a real vulgate/BORI variant, not a misprint; see the note)
शरीरस्थं|śarīra-stham|śarīra — body (first member);;stha — situated in, abiding in (śarīra-stham: 'situated in the body', acc. sg. masc., agreeing with bhūta-grāmam)
भूतग्राममचेतसः|bhūta-grāmam acetasaḥ|bhūta — element, being (first member);;grāma — aggregate, multitude, host (bhūta-grāmam: 'the aggregate of [bodily] elements', acc. sg. masc., object of karṣayantaḥ);;a-cetas — mindless, without understanding (acetasaḥ: nom. pl. masc., agreeing with the subject 'they', carried over from verse 5's janāḥ; bhūtagrāmam+acetasaḥ simply joined, final -m unaffected before the vowel)
--
मां|mām|aham — I (mām: acc. sg., object of viddhi, 'me too')
चैवान्तःशरीरस्थं|ca eva antar-śarīra-stham|ca — and;;eva — indeed, too (ca+eva→caiva, a+e→ai; caiva+antar-→caivāntar-, a+a→ā);;antar — within, inside (surface form antaḥ- before the unvoiced ś-; first member);;śarīra — body (second member);;stha — situated in, dwelling in (antar-śarīra-stham: 'dwelling within the body', acc. sg. masc., agreeing with mām)
तान्विद्ध्यासुरनिश्चयान्|tān viddhi āsura-niścayān|tad — those (tān: acc. pl., referring back to verse 5's ye janāḥ, 'those people');;vid — to know (viddhi: imperative 2nd sg., 'know!'; viddhi+āsura-→viddhyāsura-, -i+ā-→-y ā-);;āsura — demonic (first member);;niścaya — resolve, determination, conviction (āsura-niścayān: 'of demonic resolve', acc. pl. masc., predicate complement of tān)
#7

तत्प्रेत्य|tat pretya|tad — that (tat: nom. sg. neut., subject);;pra-i — having departed, after death (pretya: gerund used adverbially, 'hereafter')
नो|na u|na — not;;u — indeed, too (emphatic particle; na+u→no, a+u→o, guṇa sandhi)
इह|iha|iha — here, in this world
